excerpt: Commercial office window blind cleaning runs $15 to $35 per unit for on-site solar shade or mini-blind detailing and $25 to $48 per blind for ultrasonic tank immersion under US $55 to $95/hr specialty rates. Learn how slat material, curtain-wall height surcharges, and OSHA ladder rules shape bids.
quickAnswer: Office window blind cleaning in the US costs $15 to $32 per solar roller shade, $18 to $35 per horizontal aluminum mini-blind cleaned on-site, and $25 to $48 per blind ($1.75 to $3.25 per sq ft) for ultrasonic tank immersion. Excluded from standard $0.05 to $0.20 per sq ft janitorial contracts, detailed blind restoration bills under $55 to $95 per specialty hour with a $90 to $135 minimum visit fee.

blocks.text: Perimeter window treatments frame every client-facing conference room and executive office, yet standard janitorial crews rarely go beyond a quick feather-duster pass on reachable lower sills. Routine **$0.05 to $0.20 per sq ft** agreements in our [national office cleaning cost benchmarks](/office-cleaning-cost-guides/) exclude slat-by-slat washing, ultrasonic immersion, and high-bay roller shade detailing—leaving **office window blind cleaning cost** as a specialized periodic work order.

Because delicate aluminum slats kink easily, real wood blinds warp in water, and solar roller weaves trap sticky HVAC soot, US contractors price detailed window-treatment restoration under **$55 to $95 per specialty labor hour** (versus **$35 to $65/hr** for basic accessible dry dusting). Knowing exact per-unit and per-square-foot benchmarks helps you audit bids before issuing a seasonal purchase order.
2026 US Office Window Blind & Roller Shade Cleaning Rates

Pricing depends primarily on blind material and whether technicians clean treatments **in place** or **unmount them for ultrasonic tank immersion**. Standard commercial quotes benchmark against a typical **3-foot by 5-foot (15 sq ft)** office window unit, scaling linearly by square footage on wide floor-to-ceiling curtain walls:

blocks.title: High-Reach Curtain-Wall Glass Adds a 25% to 50% Labor Surcharge
blocks.text: Standard per-blind rates assume ground-level step-stool access under 10 feet. Perimeter executive suites, double-height lobbies, and clerestory glass requiring 12-to-18-foot A-frame ladders or rolling baker scaffolds add 25% to 50% labor time due to two-person OSHA spotting and setup.
Sample Commercial Window Budgets & Ultrasonic vs. On-Site Math

Choosing between on-site microfiber slat wiping and ultrasonic tank cleaning comes down to soil buildup and blind age. On-site HEPA brushing plus damp microfiber wiping handles light annual dust for 25% to 35% less, whereas greasy conference-room blinds near breakrooms or city street exhaust vents require ultrasonic cavitation to clean lift cords and ladders without disassembly.

blocks.text: When Ultrasonic Immersion Beats On-Site Microfiber Cleaning

Facility teams often pay for ultrasonic dipping when a fast dry-brush and microfiber wipe would suffice—or conversely ask night janitors to wet-wipe filthy kitchen-adjacent mini-blinds, streaking the cords grey:

items: **Choose On-Site HEPA + Microfiber:** Best for modern **PVC-coated solar roller shades**, **real wood blinds**, and **annual maintenance** on lightly dusty aluminum slats where avoiding takedown protects fragile valence clips.

**Choose Ultrasonic Tank Immersion:** Ideal for **3+ years of neglected soot, nicotine, or kitchen grease** on 1-inch aluminum mini-blinds and vertical PVC vanes—sound waves lift grime from braided tilt ladders that hand cloths cannot reach.

blocks.title: Audit Brittle Clip and Tilt-Cord Waivers Before Takedown
blocks.text: Ultraviolet sunlight bakes plastic mounting brackets and nylon lift cords brittle after five to seven years. Reputable ultrasonic vendors inspect three sample blinds during the walk-through and itemize replacement bracket hardware separately rather than absorbing broken-clip disputes.
Equipment and Microfiber Systems That Prevent Streaking and Sills Damage
Proper filtration and pre-charged microfiber pads stop technicians from grinding loose dust into solar shade weaves or dripping dirty rinse water onto painted drywall sills:

items: **Soft-Brush HEPA Particulate Capture:** The **Powr-Flite BP6S Comfort Pro Backpack Vacuum** combines a **6 qt** chamber, **5-Stage HEPA** filtration, **11 lb** weight, and **62 dBA** acoustic control so technicians vacuum loose pollen and HVAC carbon off roller shades before damp spotting.

**Color-Coded Pad Hygiene:** The **Rubbermaid Commercial HYGEN Charging Bucket** (**20 pads** capacity, **Snap Lid**, **Color-Coded**, **OSHA Ready**) lets crews pre-charge clean lint-free microfiber cloths with neutral cleaner and swap fresh cloths every two to three blinds—eliminating grey streaks.

**Sill & Drip Containment:** Keeping a **Rubbermaid Commercial WaveBrake 35-Quart Mop Bucket & Side-Press Wringer** (**35 qt**, **WaveBrake**, **Side-Press**, **5-Yr Wringer**) at mobile ultrasonic drain-off stations catches rinse drips before they mark hardwood or VCT perimeter floors.

blocks.text: If your team is already scheduling weekend scaffolding or lifts, pairing blind maintenance with [office chair upholstery cleaning](/office-cleaning-cost-guides/office-chair-and-upholstery-cleaning-cost/) or high-reach air diffuser dusting consolidates mobilization minimums.

blocks.title: OSHA Portable Ladder Rules, Green Chemistry, and COI Requirements
blocks.text: Any window work above 4 to 6 feet triggers OSHA Portable Ladder standards (29 CFR 1910.23)—never allow cleaners to stand on office desks or rolling task chairs. Specify fragrance-free Green Seal GS-37 neutral cleaners under OSHA HazCom (29 CFR 1910.1200) and verify a current $1M/$2M GL Certificate of Insurance before ladders enter the building.
5 Steps to Budget and Procure Commercial Blind Cleaning

items.name: Count Window Units by Material and Sill Height
items.text: Separate ground-level solar roller shades, aluminum mini-blinds, real wood slats, and >10 ft curtain-wall spans so bidders price exact labor tiers.

items.name: Match Method to Soil History Rather Than Defaulting to Ultrasonic
items.text: Use **$15 to $35/unit** on-site HEPA and microfiber cleaning for annual upkeep, reserving **$25 to $48/unit** ultrasonic immersion for heavily soiled multi-year resets.

items.name: Sync Blind Cleaning With Exterior Window Washing
items.text: Clean blinds and shades right after exterior/interior glass washing (**$15 to $35/zone** interior glass add-on) so freshly wiped slats do not immediately press against dusty panes.

items.name: Confirm Replacement Clip and Cord Contingencies in Writing
items.text: Ask vendors to carry spare headrail clips and motorized shade battery-reset protocols for conference rooms before takedown.

items.name: Audit Minimum Dispatch Fees and Specialty Hourly Math
items.text: Confirm small batches clear the **$90 to $135** visit minimum cleanly and verify full-floor bids align with **$55 to $95/hr** specialty labor.

faqs.q: Do commercial cleaning companies clean window blinds during routine nightly visits?
faqs.a: No. Standard $0.05 to $0.20 per sq ft janitorial contracts exclude detailed blind washing, solar shade spot removal, and ultrasonic cleaning. Routine crews may dust reachable bottom window sills or lightly sweep accessible blinds below 8 feet only if specifically written into the scope.

faqs.q: Can solar roller shades be cleaned with an ultrasonic tank?
faqs.a: No. Most commercial solar and blackout roller shades are tension-mounted onto aluminum clutch tubes with glued or heat-welded hems and motorized wiring—immersing them in ultrasonic tanks ruins clutches and warps fabric. They should be cleaned in place via soft-brush HEPA vacuuming and low-moisture neutral spotting.

faqs.q: How much does it cost to clean 50 office blinds in the US?
faqs.a: For 50 standard 3x5 ft aluminum mini-blinds, expect $900 to $1,750 for on-site HEPA vacuuming and microfiber slat washing ($18 to $35/blind), or $1,250 to $2,400 for off-site/mobile ultrasonic tank immersion and re-hanging ($25 to $48/blind), plus 25% to 50% if windows sit above 10 feet.

faqs.q: What OSHA and insurance requirements apply to high-bay office blind cleaning?
faqs.a: Work above standard reach requires compliance with OSHA Portable Ladder rules (29 CFR 1910.23) or scaffold certifications, OSHA HazCom (29 CFR 1910.1200) SDS sheets for spotters, and a Certificate of Insurance showing $1M/$2M Commercial General Liability and Workers' Compensation naming the tenant and landlord as Additional Insured.

faqs.q: How do recurring 4.333 weeks/month contracts handle seasonal blind cleaning?
faqs.a: Recurring janitorial contracts use 4.333 weeks per month for weekly tasks (such as 13.0 visits/mo at 3x/week), while annual or semi-annual blind cleaning is best billed as a separate fixed-price purchase order when executed—unless explicitly amortized into an annual deep-care reserve.
